query:
SELECT DISTINCT ic.cardName, cs.name as setName, ic.parallel, ic.frontImageUrl 
FROM inventory_cards ic 
JOIN card_sets cs ON ic.cardSetId = cs.id 
WHERE ic.cardName IN ('Doctor Doom', 'Thor', 'Captain America', 'Ant-Man', 'Spider-Man', 'Hulk', 'Iron Man', 'Wolverine', 'Deadpool', 'Cyclops', 'Gambit', 'Nightcrawler', 'Beast', 'Magneto', 'Invisible Woman', 'Human Torch', 'The Thing', 'Mr. Fantastic', 'Shang-Chi', 'Shuri', 'Loki', 'Captain Marvel', 'Hawkeye', 'Falcon', 'Ghost', 'Bucky Barnes', 'Winter Soldier', 'Yelena Belova', 'Sentry', 'Peggy Carter', 'Reed Richards', 'Sue Storm', 'Johnny Storm', 'Ben Grimm', 'Scott Lang', 'Sam Wilson', 'Mighty Thor')
AND ic.parallel = 'Base'
ORDER BY ic.cardName
LIMIT 60;
